_comment: The proof policy a merge gate enforces: `stepstitch proof verify fixproof.json --policy proof-policy.json --head-sha <PR head>`. Every requirement is checked OFFLINE against the proof document alone. The trust chain: trusted_keys names the ONLY public keys whose ed25519 signatures count — run `stepstitch proof keygen` on your StepStitch host, set STEPSTITCH_SIGNING_KEY there, and paste the printed public key below. This template deliberately refuses to run until you do (a placeholder key is an unusable policy, exit 2): a gate that was never configured must never read as green.
_comment_bindings: require_grade 'measured' means StepStitch itself ran the frozen reproduction red-then-green — an outcome a CI job merely asserted never passes. require_bindings true refuses any proof missing a load-bearing binding: base commit, fixed commit, failure fingerprint + red signature, frozen-test digest, execution-envelope digest, privacy-policy digest, structural result. allowed_verifier_identities names who may hold the verify credential; keep it to your host's verifier accounts.
